input.summary: Cap early termination charges at three months' charges and make them the sole termination amount payable by Customer
input.comment: [Playbook] We can accept an early termination charge, but it must be capped: our position is that no liquidated damages or penalties are payable by us, and at most an early-termination fee capped at three months' charges as the sole liquidated amount. As drafted the charge is open-ended and set in Attachment A, which IBM may change unilaterally under Section 13.1.

ops.oldText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments.
ops.newText: b. paying the applicable early termination charges, if any, specified in Attachment A and applicable Service Option Attachments, provided that such charges will not exceed, in the aggregate, three (3) months' charges for the terminated Services (calculated using the average monthly charges payable for such Services during the twelve (12) months preceding the notice date, or, if shorter, the period since the effective date) and will be the sole amount payable by Customer, and IBM's sole remedy, in respect of such termination for convenience.
